title: ActionReasoning: Robot Action Reasoning in 3D Space with LLM for Robotic Brick Stacking
authors: G. Wang, Q. Ying, **Y. Jing†**, O. Wysocki, B. Sheil

venue.name: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
